The Moon swaps Virgo for Libra today. Pretty choice.

The Moon moves from Virgo into Libra today, opposes Neptune and trines Pluto this afternoon, and trines Uranus this evening. Swipe for Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Water friend. 🌙
